description: Adaptive Surface 1.0.0 on Hytale 0.7.4 extends the internal pre-start pack cache with local material recipes, verified historical-input recovery, explicit two-family shape selection and an audited original-only public JAR while retaining saved IDs and prior working packs.
changes: Store source asset identifiers, face variants and expected pixel hashes as recipes; generate from the installed game rather than ship native texture pixels.
Require a verified old local input for eight appearances no longer present in current assets; report missing material IDs and retain a prior working pack on failure.
Expose Automatic and Normal ramp through /surface, with four native rotations per family; keep the accepted geometry and 804 saved state definitions.
Package 1.0 metadata and English authored UI without changing placement/protection code from user-accepted rc.19.
advantages: JAR-only installation on a fresh world without a separate generated download
No redistribution of native or historical texture pixels
Stable saved IDs and explicit recovery limits
disadvantages: Eight old appearances cannot be recovered when every historical input is lost
A real historical save has not been verified entering the 1.0 client
Other mods, gamepad and actual browser download are not certified by this release work
test_results: Exact 1.0 JAR SHA-256 57466464984777c48b392b905baa6326110415afcdbcab022331cb0a50b602ca; only four entries differ from accepted rc.19, and the only class change is Core manifest version metadata.

Ten native isolated runs pass after a separately preserved initial PNG I/O failure; 40 selectors, 240 Surface poses, protected refusals, 1,440 ordinary placements and reload tests pass in the harness with byte-identical production classes.
All 700 materials and 786 variants reproduce with local historical inputs; current-only run reports eight exact gaps rather than silently discarding them.
One synthetic migration passed backup/rollback hashes and native server start; exact 1.0 visual/client outcome remains with author.
